changelog:
Initial release of storyboard-master, a senior video storyboard script tool.

- Transforms creative briefs into detailed visual storyboard scripts for short films, commercials, and promotional videos.
- Outputs concise storyboard tables including shot number, size, camera movement, visual description, dialogue/voiceover, duration, lighting, color, and sound/music.
- Provides clear guides for shot types, camera techniques, pacing, and narrative structure.
- Ensures technical feasibility and budget awareness for real-world video production workflows.
- Designed for pre-production, advertising planning, and collaboration with creative teams.
